text: The war of the elephant is supposed to have terminated in the manner above mentioned about the year $60, from which time to that of Elisbean, named al- so _Clade_, and probably the same with the Adal or Av.

parsed.faithful: The war of the elephant is supposed to have terminated in the manner above mentioned about the year 360; from which time to that of Elesbaan, named also so Caleb, and probably the same with the Adad or A- Vol. I. Part I.
